approvals.reason: The residential porch is a bounded doorway target immediately outside a house footprint, and is used by commuteHumanToBuilding to set indoorBuildingId and enable legitimate sleep. The venue arc deliberately spreads social visitors much farther south of a building without signaling arrival at home. Combining these would place residents at audience distances or make leisure crowds converge on a door. Both are pure read-only calculations in the same humanMovement owner; the regression explicitly pins their different geometry and the leader-spouse arrival contract.

Distinct lifecycle contracts: discardSpotlightReturn intentionally invalidates a previous-colony camera/pause snapshot on load without returning or restoring it, whereas takeSpotlightReturn atomically returns the prior snapshot once on ordinary scene completion. They share the necessary clear operation but differ in returned values, callers, timing, and session-safety behavior; combining into a single ambiguous call would risk restoring prior colony controls. The test verifies both one-shot consume and discard-on-load semantics.
